subject.title: Back out WSL CA sync setup step

question: Should current main back out the Windows-root-to-WSL CA sync now, or keep the enterprise setup feature and repair its WSL script transport before release?
rationale: The backout removes a broken and security-sensitive main-only trust-store mutation, but it also removes the repository's current attempted fix for corporate TLS-intercepted setup.

options.title: Land the backout now
options.body: Remove the unreleased broken trust-store mutation and require any future CA-sync design to return with live setup proof and explicit trust-policy review.

options.title: Forward-fix CA sync
options.body: Keep the enterprise setup feature on main, but repair the WSL transport and provide live affected-network and normal-network setup proof before release.

options.title: Hold for enterprise setup decision
options.body: Pause this PR if corporate TLS setup support is release-critical and maintainers want the replacement design decided before any backout.

recommendation.title: Land the backout now
recommendation.body: Remove the unreleased broken trust-store mutation and require any future CA-sync design to return with live setup proof and explicit trust-policy review.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the CA-sync PR and authored the safety rewrite that created the current main implementation under review.
